QuestInfo.name: Blessings of the Fox God
QuestInfo.0: Moonbeam was waiting for you while you were giving out rice cakes. You should talk to #bMoonbeam#k
QuestInfo.1: Moonbeam was waiting for you while you were giving out rice cakes. You should talk to #bMoonbeam#k
QuestInfo.2: After giving out the rice cakes, you followed Moonbeam to go see the Fox God. To your surprise, the blessings from the Fox God that Pointy-Ear Foxes believed were actually real. Alongside the Fox God's blessing, you got a Fox Marble the foxes use to control spirits.
